## Dublin 3-Bedroom Cleaning Quote Comparison

A quick value check: **Service 1** is the best balance of price, coverage, and low-chemical preference. **Service 3** is the most thorough, while **Service 2** is the cheapest but the least complete.

## Ranked Cleaning Options

| Rank | Service | Price | Time | Coverage | Chemical Use | Best For |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | Service 1 | €120 | 3 hours | Kitchen + bathrooms | Eco-friendly products | Best overall value |
| 2 | Service 3 | €145 | 4 hours | Oven + windows included | Not specified | Most thorough clean |
| 3 | Service 2 | €95 | 2h 15m | Standard clean, no oven | Standard products | Lowest upfront cost |

### 1) Service 1 — Best Overall Value
- **Why it ranks first:** Strong mix of price, coverage, and your low-chemical priority.
- **Pros:** Eco-friendly products; includes the high-impact areas that matter most in a 3-bedroom apartment.
- **Tradeoff:** Less exhaustive than Service 3, especially if you want oven/windows included.

### 2) Service 3 — Best for Thoroughness
- **Why it ranks second:** Most complete service package and longest time on site.
- **Pros:** Includes oven and windows; same-day availability adds flexibility.
- **Tradeoff:** Highest price, and no low-chemical product promise is stated.

### 3) Service 2 — Best Budget Pick
- **Why it ranks third:** Cheapest option, but it cuts too much for your stated priorities.
- **Pros:** Lowest cost and fastest turnaround.
- **Tradeoff:** No oven cleaning, standard products only, and shorter duration suggests a lighter clean.

## Tradeoff View

- **Best value:** **Service 1** — you get eco-friendly products plus meaningful coverage without paying the premium of Service 3.
- **Best thoroughness:** **Service 3** — ideal if you want the most complete clean and are willing to pay more.
- **Best low price:** **Service 2** — only worth it if budget is the main constraint and a lighter clean is acceptable.
